# load data 
```{r}
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE)) # Clear workspace

library(dplyr)
library(skimr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(writexl) 
library(readxl)
library(stringr) # str replace all
library(broom)

DataDir<-""
KlikDir<-""
OutDir<-""

# load meta data ------
meta<- read.csv(paste0(DataDir,"2026-03-31_MetaData_participants.csv"), sep = ";" )

# load and select klik data  (watch out - old KLIK! )
klik<- read.csv(paste0(KlikDir,"klik_to_database_Booster_Maartje_Stutvoet_2026-04-09.csv"), 
                sep = ";",
                dec = ",")
  
# select participants (completed)
meta<-meta[meta$Completed==1 ,]

```

# clean data  (meta and klik)
```{r}
## dates meta ------
meta$Diag_date<-as.Date(meta$Date.diagnosis.Chronic.disease,  format = "%d-%m-%Y")
meta$T0_PreMeet_date<-as.Date(meta$Opstart,  format = "%d-%m-%Y") #T0
meta$T2_Inzichtsgesprek_date<-as.Date(meta$Inzichtgesprek,  format = "%d-%m-%Y") #T2
meta$T3_Evaluatiegesprek_date<-as.Date(meta$Evaluatiegesprek,  format = "%d-%m-%Y") #T3

# disease duration
meta$Disease_duration<-as.numeric(meta$T0_PreMeet_date- meta$Diag_date)
meta$Disease_duration<-round(meta$Disease_duration/365, 2)

## dates  -----
klik <- klik[, colSums(!is.na(klik)) > 0]

klik <- klik %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("Datum"), ~ as.Date(.x, format = "%Y-%m-%d")))

# multiple Invuldatums per row 
klik <- klik %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    same_date = {
      vals <- c_across(ends_with("InvulDatum"))
      vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
      length(vals) <= 1 || length(unique(vals)) == 1
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
table(klik$same_date) # all are the same date 

# create an invuldatum per row
klik <- klik %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Date_klik = first(na.omit(c_across(ends_with("InvulDatum"))))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


date<-meta[,c("Studienummer", "KLIK", "T0_PreMeet_date", "T2_Inzichtsgesprek_date", "T3_Evaluatiegesprek_date")]
klik<-merge(date, klik, by.x="KLIK", by.y = "PatientID") # removes the patients that did not complete the study


klik$T0_daysbefore<-as.numeric(klik$T0_PreMeet_date- klik$Date_klik) # if pos: klik before start study, if negative: klik after start study
klik$T2_daysafter<-as.numeric(klik$Date_klik- klik$T2_Inzichtsgesprek_date) # if pos: klik after Inzichtsgesprek, if negative: klik before
klik$T3_daysafter<-as.numeric(klik$Date_klik- klik$T3_Evaluatiegesprek_date) # if pos: klik after  study, if negative: klik before end  study

```
# create date format 
```{r}

klik$T0<-if_else(klik$T0_daysbefore <= 90 & klik$T0_daysbefore>= -28,1, 0)
table(klik$T0, klik$Studienummer)
# watch out: multuple timepoints, because people filled out in 2 shifts . B12, B13, B20 at the same date 

klik$T3<-if_else(klik$T3_daysafter <= 60 & klik$T3_daysafter>= -14, 1,0)
table(klik$T3, klik$Studienummer)
```

# clean questionnaires of interest  ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# CIS4 --------------------------------------
```{r}
# calculate the CIS sumscore 
#reverse coding items k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_1, k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_2, k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_4
klik <- klik %>% 
  mutate(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_1_recoded = recode(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_1, '1'=7, '2'=6, '3'=5, '4'=4, '5'=3, '6'=2, '7'=1))
klik <- klik %>% 
  mutate(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_2_recoded = recode(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_2, '1'=7, '2'=6, '3'=5, '4'=4, '5'=3, '6'=2, '7'=1))
klik <- klik %>% 
  mutate(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_4_recoded = recode(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_4, '1'=7, '2'=6, '3'=5, '4'=4, '5'=3, '6'=2, '7'=1))

#Calculate total score
klik <- klik %>% mutate(k_CIS4_total = rowSums(across(c("k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_1_recoded", "k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_2_recoded", "k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_3", "k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_4_recoded"))))
#Classify total score in group <20 geen vermoeidheid >= 20 wel vermoeidheid
klik <- klik %>% mutate(k_CIS4_total_bin = case_when(k_CIS4_total < 20 ~ 'geen vermoeidheid',
                                             k_CIS4_total >= 20 ~ 'wel vermoeidheid',
                                                       TRUE ~ NA))

```

# make wide dataset T0 T3
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

outcomes <- c(
  "FSE7",
  "k_CIS4_total",
  "k_pro_schoolparticipatie_schoolverzuim"
 
)

get_time_value <- function(df, time_flag, var) {
  df %>%
    filter(.data[[time_flag]] == 1) %>%
    group_by(Studienummer) %>%
    summarise(
      value = {
        vals <- unique(na.omit(.data[[var]]))
        if (length(vals) == 0) NA else vals[1]
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# build wide dataset
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

wide_data <- reduce(outcomes, function(acc, var) {
  
  t0 <- get_time_value(klik, "T0", var) %>%
    mutate(!!paste0(var, "_T0") := value) %>%
    select(Studienummer, !!paste0(var, "_T0"))
  
  t3 <- get_time_value(klik, "T3", var) %>%
    mutate(!!paste0(var, "_T3") := value) %>%
    select(Studienummer, !!paste0(var, "_T3"))
  
  acc %>%
    full_join(t0, by = "Studienummer") %>%
    full_join(t3, by = "Studienummer")
  
}, .init = tibble(Studienummer = unique(klik$Studienummer)))


```

# plot data
```{r}
plot_data <- wide_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Studienummer,
    names_to = c("variable", "time"),
    names_sep = "_T",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(time = paste0("T", time))


library(patchwork)

plots <- lapply(outcomes, function(v) {
  ggplot(filter(plot_data, variable == v),
         aes(x = value, fill = time)) +
    geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, position = "identity", bins = 30) +
    labs(title = v) +
    theme_minimal()
})

combined <- wrap_plots(plots)

ggsave(
  paste0(OutDir,"2026-04-09_Histograms_T0T3_klikexp20260409.jpeg"),
  combined,
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)

```

# analysis 1 : pre-post -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
paired t test
do people change? 

```{r}

run_ttest <- function(var, df) {
  
  t0 <- df[[paste0(var, "_T0")]]
  t3 <- df[[paste0(var, "_T3")]]
  
  df_pair <- data.frame(t0, t3) %>%
    filter(!is.na(t0) & !is.na(t3))
  
  ttest <- t.test(df_pair$t3, df_pair$t0, paired = TRUE)
  
  tidy(ttest) %>%
    mutate(variable = var) %>%
    select(variable, estimate, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high)
}


# run statistics on the complete set
wide_data_sel<-wide_data[!wide_data$Studienummer %in% c("B04", "B10"),]

results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(outcomes, run_ttest, df = wide_data_sel))

summaries <- lapply(outcomes, function(v) {
  
  tibble(
    variable = v,
    mean_T0 = mean(wide_data_sel[[paste0(v, "_T0")]], na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_T0   = sd(wide_data_sel[[paste0(v, "_T0")]], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_T3 = mean(wide_data_sel[[paste0(v, "_T3")]], na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_T3   = sd(wide_data_sel[[paste0(v, "_T3")]], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# make one overview
ressum<-merge(summaries, results, by="variable")
ressum[, 2:10]<-round(ressum[, 2:10], 2)
ressum <- ressum %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = outcomes)) %>%
  arrange(variable)


# save the output
write_xlsx(ressum, paste0(OutDir, "2026-04-15_pairedTtest_T0T3_klikexp20260409_B23Added.xlsx"))

```
